messages:
ci-bot: Automated CI alert — reserved-capacity e2e perf job failed (build #9876). p95=3200ms, error rate 0.4% :rotating_light:

devon: seeing a staircase p95 increase in staging after the last merge (PR #4892). spikes align with kernel-hinting changes. graph: <https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abc/reserved-capacity-staging?view=latency>|link

maria: ack. can you paste the short repro or the exact commit range?

devon: repro script attached in workspace but quick range is `main~3..main` where `main^` is commit `abc1234` -> suspect `runtime/kernel-routing: auto-hint-priority` commit.

jasper: I ran a quick `perf` on a repro pod, nothing obvious on CPU — GPU kernels switch frequently. p95 jumps when we switch from `kernel-v2` -> `kernel-v1-fallback` mid-sequence.

sophie: that matches the KV-cache thrash I saw in traces — when kernel changes, KV segment layout invalidates and we miss hot prefixes. TTLs spike and we repopulate: more GPU work, longer tails.

devon: here's the profiler snippet from the failing CI run:
```
GPU kernels: call_count
kernel-v2: 435 -> avg 1.1ms
kernel-v1-fallback: 123 -> avg 9.8ms
KV fetch ops: 22k -> 78k during spike
```

taolu: interesting — batching heuristics might be pushing sequences to a different kernel path due to new hint order. new heuristic favors grouped shorter seqs which changes compilation path.

maria: is this reproducing locally with `--enable-autohint` on?\
jasper: yes, repro with `--enable-autohint` + reserved-capacity config hits it reliably in staging. Without autohint it's stable.\
devon: CI diff shows the change touched `kernel_router.go` and `batch_scheduler.lua`. suspect interaction between kernel hint ordering and prefetch window.

infra-bot: Deploy pipeline note: staging-capacity was running canary with `runtime:v2024.11-autohint` at 3 nodes. Rollout paused automatically due to SLA guard.

ops-oncall: ops watching — we have a few customers on reserved pools in staging mirror, risk to Dedicated SLA if this leaks to prod.

maria: plan: revert the autohint commit from the staging canary (hot rollback) to recover p95 immediately, then bisect to find minimal delta. agree? :eyes:

devon: +1 for rollback. can we do a targeted revert instead of full roll? need to keep other runtime fixes.

jasper: I can prepare the revert PR for `runtime/kernel-routing: auto-hint-priority` and a temporary feature flag to disable autohint on reserved-capacity pools.

taolu: we'll also run a controlled bisect across commits `abc1200..abc1250` and collect kernel selection traces. I can add additional logging for `selected_kernel` + `batch_signature` to make the bisect actionable.

sophie: add a histogram for KV miss latency per kernel in the repro harness — want to confirm the eviction correlation.

devon: quick mitigation ideas: 1) disable autohint for reserved pools 2) pin kernel routing to v2-only for streaked workloads 3) increase prefetch window to reduce evictions. Which one is fastest?

maria: fastest is (1) via feature flag. (2) requires pinning logic and config rollout. (3) might hide root cause. do (1) now.

infra-bot: Action triggered: feature-flag update queued — `autohint_reserved=false` — will apply to staging canary in ~5m.

ci-bot: Perf job retriggered (#9877) after flag flip.

jasper: running `make repro-run` against staging with flag off.

devon: prelim after flag flip: p95 back to ~950ms, no staircase in 30m window. :thumbsup:

ops-oncall: good. keep monitoring for 2 hours and hold prod rollout until bisect completes.

maria: owners: jasper + taolu for bisect and revert PR. devon + sophie for KV/tracing and perf dashboards. i'll coordinate customer comms if prod hold extends.

taolu: bisect plan: run binary search with injected sampling (1000 sequences per commit), collect `selected_kernel`, `kv_miss_rate`, `batch_size_dist`. script: `tools/perf/bisect_kernel.sh --range abc1200..abc1250 --out /tmp/bisect_runs`

jasper: I pushed a draft revert PR: PR#4902 (revert of auto-hint commit) and a feature flag gate. requesting review from infra and runtime.

devon: great. once revert lands we'll re-run full reserved-capacity canary and promote if stable. leave rollback window 1h.

maria: post-mortem items: 1) add CI perf test that exercises kernel transitions under KV pressure 2) add automatic detection of kernel-path-churn 3) warn on p95 staircase pattern in alerting

sophie: noted. I'll add traces and a small eval prompt set to our regression suite.

ops-oncall: tagging oncall for next 2 hours for escalation: @ops-oncall (this is already them) :pray:

ci-bot: Update: rerun #9877 PASS (p95=920ms).

devon: closing loop — revert PR merged to staging, feature flag left off for reserved pools. starting targeted bisect now. will update thread with results. :rocket:
